name: self-programming-agent
description: Voice-controlled desktop agent that turns tasks into programs and fixes its own code.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c magenta,cyan "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node scripts/run-electron.cjs"

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Agent listens for “Hey Agent” when you turn on the mic button, so you can speak tasks.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Agent opens and switches between apps you ask it to use.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Agent recognises “Hey Agent” and your spoken task on this Mac.
